div.div:
The reply is as slow as the slowest leaf.
If each leaf is slow on 1% of requests (p = 0.01) and there are N = 100 leaves,
P(the user waits for a slow leaf) = 1 − (1 − p)N = 1 − 0.99100 ≈ 63%

text.tspan: The reply is as slow as the slowest leaf.
If each leaf is slow on 1% of requests (p = 0.01) and there are N = 100 leaves,
P(the user waits for a slow leaf) = 1 − (1 − p)N = 1 − 0.99100 ≈ 63%
